analyst_view.overall: Braga (17th, 4 pts) host KuPS (33rd, 1 pt) and need the win to move toward the top 24. New coach Franclim Carvalho, in since October, has steadied Braga with a 4-2-3-1 built around Fran Navarro, and they won 2-0 at Vitoria de Guimaraes in the cup on Saturday (Horta penalty, Navarro). Braga prepare without Sikou Niakate, whom the numbers already list, and striker Jonas Wind, out with physical overload, whom they don't; with Horta (8 goals), Pau Victor (7) and Navarro available the loss is small. KuPS' Finnish season ended on 8 November, so they arrive after a long break with one European point and few goals (0-0 with Gent, 2-4 v Trabzonspor), something the numbers cannot see. The numbers already count Braga's heavy recent shot output (+26%); no referee has been named yet.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.6 goals, about 2.1 of them Braga's. I lean a little higher: KuPS' league season is over and they arrive after weeks without a competitive match, which the numbers can't see, while Braga's attack is scoring again under Franclim even without Wind. A mild +4% gives about 2.7 goals.

corners.text: The numbers say 9.6 corners, about 7 for Braga, already lifted 9% for Braga's recent corner count and cut for KuPS' few. KuPS will mostly defend deep, which the split already reflects, so I stay at about 9.6.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.0 cards, already trimmed for both sides' recent quiet discipline. A one-sided game against a team defending deep usually stays calm and no referee is named yet, so I stay at about 4.0.

shots.text: The numbers say 29.7 shots, already pushed up 26% for Braga's recent shot volume and down 13% for KuPS'. KuPS' rustiness argues for even more Braga pressure, but Braga played a cup tie on Saturday and may rotate, and the numbers already carry a big lift, so I stay at about 29.7.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 10.1 shots on target, 7.5 of them Braga's. A KuPS side out of season should give up cleaner chances than usual, which the numbers can't see, and Navarro's return to scoring helps Braga's finishing, so I lean slightly higher: +3% gives about 10.4.
